$comment: UI shell authority registry — read by scripts/audit-ui-authority.ts (npm run audit:ui-authority). Every entry with a `path` is checked against the tree: `active` must exist, `deleted` must not, `demoted` must exist and be imported by nothing under client/src. Entries without a path are destinations, checked against the rail arrays in client/src/concept2cure/v2/registryModel.ts and the account menu in Shell.tsx. Updated 2026-09-06 (docs/audits/ANA_UI_FORENSIC_AUDIT_2026-09-06.md).

decision.summary: The rail is NOT to be collapsed to the constitution's five destinations (PR #1187 reverted in full); .pj-title, .ana-ctx-section and .ana-greet-t stay serif. The navigation shipping today is the intended navigation.

app-router.role: outer <Switch>: auth aliases, /client-portal redirects, catch-all → ZenRouter

zen-router.role: auth entry + redirects; mounts the persistent v2 shell for / and /concept2cure/*

v2-app.role: THE shell frame: .c2c-v2.shell grid rail | main | ana; internal surface routing

surface-views.role: surface id → lazy component + full/ownsConversation layout flags

registry-model.role: the one nav source: RAIL_CORE / RAIL_SPECIALIST / RAIL_EXPLORE / RAIL_QUICK, NAV_HIDDEN, SEGMENT_MODULES, DEEP_LINK_ALIASES

canonical.role: the only token source; pinned by tests/ui/token-authority.test.ts

alias-shim.role: alias shim only (--accent-*, --dur, --rail); may not redeclare bg/text/border/radius/font

shell-metrics.role: shell layout metrics (--rail, --ana) + chrome CSS + responsive rules

home.role: Home landing: greeting + composer seeding conversation-thread (chat-first front door); the segment module grid moved to capability-browser 2026-09-07

capability-browser.role: the segment module catalogue, in an overlay off Home; reads getSegmentModules + getSurfaceMeta and adds a search. Not a destination — it has no surface id and is opened only by Home

projects.role: portfolio directory (summary line, search, two-column cards) + new-project wizard

project-landing.role: project home; conversation panel + capability grid + readiness (shape escalated, see work order)

communication-center.role: agency-communication loop: FDA loop, agency inbox, meetings & commitments, authority profiles; not a rail item (deep link, ⌘K, project home, AnA navigate_to)

apps.role: Apps catalog (module subscriptions) + admin console, licensing, usage, billing

mdx-host.role: former second app, now a chromeless hosted surface inside the v2 shell

pdev-app.role: former second app, now hosted surfaces inside the v2 shell (rail/topbar/AnA rail belong to the shell)

chats.note: Explore › Conversation, plus the Home composer and the AnA rail

communication-center.note: not a rail item by the 2026-07-28 decision; reachable via ⌘K, deep link, project home, AnA navigate_to
